title: Streaming Data Engineer
description: As a Data Engineer in the DPG Network Area, you leverage the daily reach of millions of readers and viewers on our online platforms as a competitive advantage by stitching together user interactions and building real-time profiles across our entire digital ecosystem. You build cloud-based streaming data pipelines and its underlying infrastructure. In short: you live up to our principle You Build It, You Run It. DPG Network Area At DPG Media we all contribute to our mission to entertain, inspire and inform as many people as possible. Here at the DPG Network Area specifically we are at the very centre of our digital strategy. As such you’ll have the opportunity to join a team whose everyday activities have a real impact on our company, and perhaps even digital media as a whole. How will you make a difference? Design & Build Event-Driven Services: Design and implement scalable streaming applications using Apache Kafka and Kafka Streams, applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to model bounded contexts for identity stitching and user profiling. Lead the Batch-to-Streaming Migration: Migrate legacy Spark batch processing pipelines into real-time, event-driven streaming applications, reducing latency from hours to milliseconds. Handle High Scale & Throughput: Optimize data pipelines capable of processing terabytes of event data daily with low latency, high availability, and strong fault tolerance. Deploy & Operate on AWS/EKS: Own your applications end-to-end, deploying microservices to Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) using modern CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and cloud-native observability. Collaborate & Mentor: Partner with stakeholders, privacy specialists, fellow developers to translate complex business domains into clean, event-driven domain models. Your must-have knowledge and experience Experience implementing highly available and scalable big data solutions In depth knowledge of at least one cloud provider, preferably AWS Proficiency in languages such as Scala, Python or Java specifically in the context of streaming data workflows Experience with Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD pipelines Understanding of modern software engineering best practices Experience with Domain-driven design DevOps mindset You see the value in a team and enjoy working together with others, also with techniques like pair-programming You either have an AWS certification or are willing to achieve AWS certification within 6 months (minimum: AWS Certified Associate) Nice to have knowledge Experience building highly automated infrastructures Experience with Kubernetes. Expertise in designing, analysing and troubleshooting large-scale distributed systems Define and deploy monitoring, metrics, and logging systems, and automated security controls Systematic problem-solving approach, coupled with strong communication skills Familiarity with functional programming principles Dive into our data story If you’re considering this job but would like to know what you are getting yourself into first, we’ve got some great content for you. Data Mesh at DPG Media Meet Data Engineer Jochen What We Offer At DPG Media, we are open to all talent in society. Regardless of your background, we invite you to apply for this position. We believe that the differences between colleagues are exactly what lead to surprising insights and innovative solutions—which aligns perfectly with our identity as an organization. We are curious to know who you are and the unique qualities and experience you bring to the table. If you’d like to learn more about our inclusive work environment, click here! At DPG Media, you’ll join an inspiring work environment that is constantly in motion. Through our DPG Academy , we offer a variety of courses, giving you every opportunity to reach your full potential! 💼 Competitive salary package You will receive an attractive salary supplemented by fringe benefits such as a company car, meal vouchers, and a comprehensive insurance package. 🕒 Flexible working With flexible working hours and working-from-home options, you can organize your workweek in a way that keeps work and private life in balance. 🚴 Tailored mobility We provide mobility solutions that perfectly align with your preferred way of traveling. 🎓 Continuous development Through the DPG Media Academy, you will have access to training and development programs that support your professional growth. 🌴 Room to recharge With 32 days of annual leave, you will have plenty of time to relax and recharge your batteries. 🏢 Inspiring working environment(s) Get inspired in our vibrant hubs in Antwerp or Amsterdam—working across locations is perfectly possible. Applying, and then what? Are you a top performer in your field, or do you have the ambition to become one? Do you thrive in a warm, creative, and vibrant environment where you are constantly challenged? Apply via the button and let’s explore what we can mean for each other. Because your talent is welcome at DPG Media, regardless of your background and preferences. Want to know more? Please contact Toon Hertogs via toon.hertogs@persgroep.net. #DPG Media België
